label: Diagram 3.3
caption: Diagram 3.3 Floor type 1.1C – floor type 1.1 with ceiling treatment C
description: A section headed "Diagram 3.3 Floor type 1.1C – floor type 1.1 with ceiling treatment C", marked "SECTION" at the lower right. A thick concrete floor slab, drawn with a speckled pattern, has a thin layer on top (the soft floor covering). Under the slab, three small square timber battens, each marked with a cross, carry a ceiling drawn as a thin band along the bottom. There are no labels or dimensions.
